quote.text: You don't get paid for activity. You get paid for the close. Everything before the close is just cost.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check GHL/Calendly for new bookings before noon.
focus: Capital One flagged a payment held for a security check until June 17. Confirm this isn't the card funding your FB Ads ($35/day) — a declined charge kills delivery on your only live lead channel and you won't get a second warning.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at a $17 CPL — roughly $460 spent on people who never booked. The gap is follow-up, not traffic. Run a personal call-and-text blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link instead of waiting on automation that's still stuck in A2P review.

FB Ads spend was already collapsing before the data feed went stale on Jun 7: $8.48 that day against a $35 budget, down from $20.93 on Jun 5 and $44.44 on Jun 4. Open Ads Manager, confirm it's still delivering, and refresh the Missed Call / Two Phones creative before your only active channel dries up.
